packs.name: Off to Hackfest
packs.author: annejan
packs.about: Hackfest is on Saturday, from noon, at Sickhouse in Enschede. A few things first. Geeky things.

contents.name: Pull request
contents.hint: The merge button wants a cube. The cube is on the shelf.

contents.name: Reflow the badge
contents.hint: The hot air is up on the shelf. The badge is down on the plate.

contents.name: Power banks
contents.hint: One launcher per power bank. Both banks full, or the front door stays shut.

contents.name: Pack the bag
contents.hint: Two gadgets, two pockets. One sits up high, one down in the drawer.

contents.name: Platform 11b
contents.hint: The train runs while the cube is on its button. The cube is on the rack.

contents.name: Change at Amersfoort
contents.hint: Check in at the pole. The doors close in two and a half seconds.

contents.name: 160 km of headwind
contents.hint: Orange gel makes you fast. Pour a run-up on the path, and jump at its end.

contents.name: The dyke
contents.hint: Bikes cannot climb a dyke. Bring the blue gel to its foot, and bounce.

contents.name: Loading the van
contents.hint: The gear is in the attic. The gap in the van is too high. The plate is not.

contents.name: Speed cameras
contents.hint: They watch the road, not the sky. Your cargo can take the scenic route.

contents.name: The Wi-Fi
contents.hint: The funnel goes where the portals send it. The truss is six metres up.

contents.name: Daisy chain
contents.hint: Daisy-chain the beam through both power strips to the stage. Meet the bridge.

packs.name: Human in the loop
packs.author: annejan
packs.about: Aperture's test generator needs a human to break its drafts. You are the human.

contents.name: Hold the door
contents.hint: A draft: find a way she did not mean. The final draft: the way she did.

contents.name: Pressure
contents.hint: The ferry sails when every button is down, and not a second longer.

contents.name: Light work
contents.hint: The cube is in the right place. It is facing the wrong way.

contents.name: Wet floor
contents.hint: The mop water is in the cupboard. The floor that needs it is out in the hall.

contents.name: Break room
contents.hint: A panel is missing low in the far wall. Somebody lives behind it. Bring a cube.

contents.name: Second opinion
contents.hint: Two faults. One is in the pipe. The other is where you would aim.

contents.name: Observation
contents.hint: Portals bring the beam down to you. Only a cube turns it the last corner.

contents.name: Momentum
contents.hint: Nothing in here gives you speed. Make your own, then pass it on.

contents.name: The last draft
contents.hint: The plate aims at the turret. Give it something to throw.

packs.name: After hours
packs.author: annejan
packs.about: The tests are over. The testing is not.

contents.name: Overtime
contents.hint: Everything you have learned, in the right order.

contents.name: Momentum
contents.hint: Nothing in here gives you speed. Make your own, then pass it on.

contents.name: Rush hour
contents.hint: Walk in, and a floor portal is a step. Run in, and it is an escalator.

contents.name: Cleaning crew
contents.hint: Gel only ever falls. A portal decides which way is down.

contents.name: Courier
contents.hint: Do not handle the parcel. That is what the funnel is for.

contents.name: Two-way street
contents.hint: The funnel runs both ways. Not at the same time, and not for long.

contents.name: Reflections
contents.hint: Portals move a beam. Only a cube turns one. Take a moment for reflection.

contents.name: Bowling night
contents.hint: Gravity bowls harder than you do. The second ball learns from the first.

contents.name: Lights out
contents.hint: Two portals will not get it there. The pellet will not wait while you think.

contents.name: Night shift
contents.hint: The night watch only looks one way. Send the bridge the other way.

contents.name: Crunch time
contents.hint: The deadline is six seconds away. The commute is eight. Work from home.

contents.name: Shop Floor
contents.hint: Too far to walk, too far to shoot. Plan it from the gallery.

contents.name: Canyon
contents.hint: Everything worth reaching is far away. Make the far things come to you.

contents.name: Spire
contents.hint: A fall keeps its speed through a portal. Only the top is high enough.
